topics.name: Boot USE Selection
topics.purpose: Define `use`/`user` selection semantics so when a restrictive selection list is present, only explicitly listed components plus valid required closure are candidates for activation.

semantics.restrictive_rule: If a restrictive `use` or `user` selection is present, unlisted optional components are excluded.
semantics.group_rule: Named groups/presets, if used, expand through explicit declared membership.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown selectors hard-fail rather than fuzzy-match.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Duplicate selectors normalize deterministically without creating duplicate runtime identities.
semantics.closure_rule: Required dependency closure is validated separately and does not imply broad auto-enable.
semantics.authority_rule: USE selection controls availability, not AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: Boot/runtime availability is derived only from explicit profile selection plus validated dependency closure; discovery, installation, dependency presence or historical activation never silently enables a component.

hard_gates.condition: group membership inferred from folder structure
duplicate selector creates duplicate runtime instance

references.purpose: USE adds explicit capabilities from zero baseline.
